title: TDCS Modulation of Visual Cortex in Motor Imagery
description: EEG dataset investigating transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) modulation of visual cortex during motor imagery. Recordings were acquired with a Brain Products EEG system at 5000 Hz from a small group of healthy adult participants across three recording sessions. The dataset is organized in BIDS format.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Brain Products system sampled at 5000 Hz with 60 Hz line noise, across 3 sessions and 90 scans in total. Recording durations ranged from about 364 to 2911 seconds per scan. The data were organized into BIDS using MNE-BIDS.
